description: Central Bank of Sri Lanka - Microfinance Act No. 6 oj 2016 - Notice no deadline for on application for a licence
categorisation: This gazette content is a notice from the Central Bank of Sri Lanka regarding compliance requirements and licensing deadlines under the Microfinance Act, No. 6 of 2016. It deals with regulatory frameworks, statutory compliance requirements, and the implementation of existing legislation, which falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5). While it mentions the Governor by name, it does not involve government personnel changes or structural reorganization, and the focus is purely on regulatory compliance rather than personal appointments or portfolio assignments.
